verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an AI Assistant inside the Dashboard that gives recommendations tailored to the table you are working on, suggests fixes for SQL errors, and offers schema guidance. That is in-product AI suggestion, but it is oriented to database management rather than to insights drawn from the data's contents. The Advisors are deterministic checks, not AI-generated, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented AI analysis of data contents (trends, summaries, anomalies), examples of insight outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience
while working on a specific table, the Assistant can provide instant feedback and recommendations tailored to that context.
Schema Design Assistance: Receive guidance on structuring your database and generating SQL queries.
